event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status: 1.0 = death (event); 0.0 = censored / alive at last follow-up (inferred)

notes: Provenance: 'Months', 'Dx Date', 'Survival Date', and 'Survival Status' columns are present in the provided supplementary data snippet.
The paper Methods (Time-to-event analyses) explicitly describe using overall survival (OS) for time-to-event analyses on the cohort.
'Months' appears to be the follow-up time (time-to-event) likely computed as the interval between 'Dx Date' and 'Survival Date'.

The numeric coding of 'Survival Status' is not explicitly defined in the supplementary file; mapping 1.0 = death (event) and 0.0 = censored/alive is inferred by comparing short 'Months' values and corresponding 'Survival Date' entries and by the Methods statement that patients were followed until death or last follow-up.
Some other fields in the supplementary data show 'NaN' or special marks (e.g., '△', 'x') for other columns; no other event encodings were observed in the provided rows.
